scope: Public-input AES permutation screen with varying full128-bit inputs, Node Wasm SIMD. Mode0 RustCrypto0.9.1, mode1 existing FourBlockAes128. Both use64-bit fixslice. No complete preparation claim.
manifest:
[package]
name = "ml-dsa-aes-screen"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]
[dependencies]
aes = { version = "=0.9.1", features = ["zeroize"] }
zeroize = "=1.9.0"
cipher = { version = "=0.5.2", features = ["zeroize"] }
[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"
